declined.subject: pre-publish-fillability-forecast
declined.reason: The supplied tests exercise job normalization, recruiter ranking, salary plausibility, benchmark provenance, interviews, intake and campaigns, but contain no assertions for assess_winnability, eligibleDelta, qualifiedDelta, belowMarket or the joint counterfactual outputs; dedicated winnability tests exist elsewhere in the same directory, so borrowing their evidence would not judge the supplied context.
